steps.en: On an Apple-silicon Mac, install the Python package from a clone
steps.zh: 在 Apple 芯片的 Mac 上，从克隆的仓库安装 Python 包

steps.en: Download one of the two published tiers into a local directory
steps.zh: 把两个已发布档位之一下载到本地目录

steps.en: Lands one ready-to-run directory: int4 base checkpoint plus its trained LoRA and prerouter files
steps.zh: 落地一个即可运行的目录：int4 底座加配套训练好的 LoRA 和预路由文件

steps.en: Point the tier name at that directory and start the server
steps.zh: 把档位名指向这个目录，启动服务

steps.en: Maps expert weights on the SSD instead of loading them, attaches both adapters, serves on 127.0.0.1:8000
steps.zh: 专家权重留在固态硬盘上按需映射，挂上两个适配器，在本机 8000 端口提供服务

steps.en: Send chat requests from any OpenAI-style client
steps.zh: 用任意 OpenAI 风格的客户端发聊天请求

steps.en: Per token, predicts the next layer's experts one step early so SSD reads overlap compute
steps.zh: 每生成一个词，提前一步预测下一层要用的专家，读盘与计算重叠

component.zh: 预路由头加流式专家池

value.en: A 35B MoE model answers on a 24 GB Mac inside about 3 GiB of peak active memory, without holding the 23 GB checkpoint in RAM
value.zh: 35B 的 MoE 模型在 24 GB 的 Mac 上作答，峰值活跃内存约 3 GiB，23 GB 的检查点不必装进内存

sources: README.md Getting Started > Python: 1) Install (python3.12 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -e '.[dev,fetch]'), 2) Download a model (.venv/bin/python scripts/fetch_models.py --tier edge0-35b --target-dir models; directory holds config/model safetensors + lora_edge0_35b.safetensors + prerouter_edge0_35b.safetensors), 3) Point edge0 at it (export EDGE0_35B_MODEL=$PWD/models/edge0-35b), 4) Run (edge0 serve edge0-35b; curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/chat/completions)
README.md About > Core mechanisms (SSD expert offload, prerouter predicts routing one step ahead, Recover-LoRA unmerged) and Benchmark (2.9 GiB peak active memory, Mac mini M4 Pro 24 GB)
docs/prerouter.md (layer N head predicts layer N+1 routing at token t-1; staged set == routed set)
